notes: Background: mid-market SaaS (product analytics) building an in-app assistant + reranking for search. Started on Hosted API to move fast; hit variability at peak hours and want Dedicated for predictable P99. Customer explicitly: \"need <120ms median and <250ms P95 for chat on common queries\" (target). POC ask: 4-week Dedicated POC to validate latency and cost delta vs hosted, plus integration of VPC peering and KMS. POC plan (high level): canary traffic split -> staged rollout -> full cutover with rollback plan. Details captured in runbook: - Week 0: infra prep (VPC, peering, KMS keys, service accounts). - Week 1 (canary 10%): deploy model variant A (quantized performance profile) to Dedicated pool in us-east-1; route 10% of traffic from hosted to Dedicated; monitor latency, error rates, cost/tokens. - Week 2 (canary 30%): increase to 30% if SLOs met; enable KV/prefix caching on Dedicated nodes; compare embeddings throughput vs hosted. - Week 3 (regional failover test): deploy model variant B (smaller, cheaper) in eu-west-1 for failover; simulate us-east-1 outage to validate region failover + fallback routing policies. - Week 4: rollback window and final decision. Canary metrics: latency P50/P95/P99, token cost/unit, model output quality (BLEU/semantic similarity on eval set), tail error impact. Model variants considered: Llama-3-70B-8k-quantized (primary), Mistral-22B or smaller variant for fallback. Routing policy: prefer lowest-latency pool, fall back to cheaper variant when Dedicated pool saturated, cross-region fallback to eu-west with reduced QoS if necessary. Rollback: immediate traffic revert to Hosted API route + alerting to SRE + postmortem template. Customer comments: \"We care about predictable unit economics and not being surprised by burst billing\". Security: must pass SOC2 checklist; want example audit logs (sent), KMS key policy examples, and SSO test account. Open items: precise GPU counts for committed pool, final pricing for >30% traffic sustained, legal/data residency clause for EU customers. Next actions: send Dedicated POC contract addendum + pricing worksheet, schedule infra kickstart (SE + their infra), formalize failover SLAs and run simulated failover date.
use_case_summary: Primary: in-app conversational assistant (chat) + query reranking for document search and personalized summaries. High throughput during weekly analytics runs; medium cost sensitivity but high operational SLAs. Expect steady baseline traffic with daily peaks. Want routing policy for latency-sensitive reads and cheaper fallback for background batch rerank jobs.
